blocks.text: You can use your profile in the Breach Predictor Portal to see basic information about your username, subscription, organization ID, and the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) instance that Breach Predictor is connected to. Additionally, you can integrate Breach Predictor with other applications to expand the functionality available to your organization.
Your profile provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View basic user and organizational profile information.
Integrate Breach Predictor with other applications.

blocks.text: On the My Profile page (Breach Predictor Portal > My Profile), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View Basic User and Organizational Information
On the User Detail tab, you can do the following:
Log out of the Breach Predictor Portal.
See basic user and organizational information.
View and Create Integrations with Various Applications
On the Integration tab, you can do the following:
Switch to the User Detail tab.
Log out of the Breach Predictor Portal.
See which applications are available for integration with Breach Predictor and configure them.
To learn more, see Integrating Applications with Zscaler Breach Predictor.
